mathematical_semantics: a representation correspondence is a directional structural witness w_{A->B} = (mu_V, I+, I-, B, E_w, U_w) over scoped structural objects S=(V,E,chi,gamma,q,epsilon), licensed only for the registered quantity of interest; directional, context-scoped and non-transitive - A->B and B->C do not license A->C unless the composed obligations are separately satisfied

the witness is interpreted as a finite typed transport obligation set with per-obligation status SATISFIED | VIOLATED | UNKNOWN; failing to establish a precondition is never evidence that the precondition is false

transition_semantics: non-compensatory transfer decision: LICENSED iff every load-bearing obligation is SATISFIED; REJECTED iff at least one is demonstrably VIOLATED; CANNOT_CHECK otherwise - preserved relations cannot buy back a violated boundary or forbidden loss

REJECTED refines into MERELY_UNLICENSED vs CERTIFIABLY_IMPOSSIBLE; the strong verdict requires a closed-world completeness declaration, a completed bounded exhaustion over witness presentations, and a witness-independent obstruction; budget exhaustion or an open-world target always yields the weak verdict

failure_signatures: failure:ABSORB.REPRESENTATION_MAP.v0:false-impossibility-certificate - a refusal caused by a repairable witness-local defect is relabelled as proof that no witness can work
falsifiers: one false impossibility certificate on a case where a licensing witness demonstrably exists kills the mechanism; never firing CERTIFIABLY_IMPOSSIBLE on genuinely impossible closed-world cases makes it vacuous; never differing from the naive relabelling import makes the distinction empty
